down_idle.action: front view facing the viewer; idle, tiny 1-pixel breathing bob

down_walk.action: front view facing the viewer; classic 4-frame overworld walk: step left foot, neutral, step right foot, neutral

downside_idle.action: 45-degree three-quarter FRONT view turned toward camera-right; idle, tiny 1-pixel breathing bob

downside_walk.action: 45-degree three-quarter FRONT view turned toward camera-right; classic 4-frame overworld walk: step left foot, neutral, step right foot, neutral

side_idle.action: strict side profile facing RIGHT; idle, tiny 1-pixel breathing bob

side_walk.action: strict side profile facing RIGHT; classic 4-frame overworld walk: step left foot, neutral, step right foot, neutral

upside_idle.action: 45-degree three-quarter BACK view turned away toward upper-right (no eyes visible); idle, tiny 1-pixel breathing bob

upside_walk.action: 45-degree three-quarter BACK view turned away toward upper-right (no eyes visible); classic 4-frame overworld walk: step left foot, neutral, step right foot, neutral

up_idle.action: back view facing away (no face visible); idle, tiny 1-pixel breathing bob

up_walk.action: back view facing away (no face visible); classic 4-frame overworld walk: step left foot, neutral, step right foot, neutral

down_hoe.action: front view facing the viewer; using a wooden hoe with an iron blade: 1 raise the hoe over the head, 2 strike the blade down into the ground in front, 3 recover holding the hoe

down_water.action: front view facing the viewer; using a small grey-blue tin watering can: 1 lift the can, 2 tilt it forward pouring (2-3 blue water pixels attached to the spout), 3 lower the can

down_lasso.action: front view facing the viewer; rope lasso: 1 twirl a small rope loop above the head, 2 swing the loop forward at arm length (rope stays attached to the hand), 3 pull the rope back tight

side_hoe.action: strict side profile facing RIGHT; using a wooden hoe with an iron blade: 1 raise the hoe over the head, 2 strike the blade down into the ground in front, 3 recover holding the hoe

side_water.action: strict side profile facing RIGHT; using a small grey-blue tin watering can: 1 lift the can, 2 tilt it forward pouring (2-3 blue water pixels attached to the spout), 3 lower the can

side_lasso.action: strict side profile facing RIGHT; rope lasso: 1 twirl a small rope loop above the head, 2 swing the loop forward at arm length (rope stays attached to the hand), 3 pull the rope back tight

up_hoe.action: back view facing away; using a wooden hoe with an iron blade: 1 raise the hoe over the head, 2 strike the blade down into the ground in front, 3 recover holding the hoe

up_water.action: back view facing away; using a small grey-blue tin watering can: 1 lift the can, 2 tilt it forward pouring (2-3 blue water pixels attached to the spout), 3 lower the can

up_lasso.action: back view facing away; rope lasso: 1 twirl a small rope loop above the head, 2 swing the loop forward at arm length (rope stays attached to the hand), 3 pull the rope back tight
